title: fix(lint): the approval and flow advisories a flow save returns carry a user sentence in every platform locale
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWK5rFW1SUGSkDw9iatZE4f)_

Fixes #32836

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：保存流程（含审批节点）时返回的 19 类提示，现在都带一句面向用户的话，覆盖平台全部 11 种语言；规则 id、英文 message 和 hint 一字未改。
- **为什么改**：此前这些提示只有给开发者看的英文，中文等界面的用户在保存流程时看到的是看不懂的技术句；这是 #32655 已落地做法在自动化领域的延续。
- **风险与回滚**：只新增文案和 `userTextParams` 字段，不改变哪些写入被拒、哪些通过；回滚即撤销本 PR。`os validate --json` / `os build --json` 的 warnings 里会多出 `userTextParams` 键。
- **先看**：`validate-approval-approvers.user-text.ts`（8 条审批提示，最贴近用户），再看 `finding-user-text.test.ts` 里按真实流程经保存门渲染的用例。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/finding-user-text.test.ts`，102 个用例全绿，每条都从真实流程经运行时保存门取出并逐语言渲染。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Nineteen advisory rule ids that the save door returns on a flow write now carry `userTextParams` and a user sentence in all eleven `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS`. Each rule file gets a `*.user-text.ts` catalog beside it, and the six catalogs merge into `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG` through `mergeUserTextCatalogs`, the way #32655 landed `validate-security-posture.user-text.ts`.

| Rule file | Catalog | Ids |
|---|---|---|
| `validate-approval-approvers.ts` | `APPROVAL_APPROVERS_USER_TEXT` | `approval-approver-type-unknown`, `approval-expression-invalid` (its `info` arm only), `approval-approver-not-membership-tier`, `approval-approver-type-deprecated`, `approval-approver-type-unsupported`, `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty`, `approval-expression-no-empty-policy`, `approval-escalation-reassign-no-target` |
| `validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts` | `FLOW_TRIGGER_READINESS_USER_TEXT` | `flow-trigger-unknown-object`, `flow-input-unknown-object` (advisory arm, no package closure), `flow-input-object-less`, `flow-input-record-read-as-list`, `flow-draft-status-ambiguous` |
| `validate-flow-template-paths.ts` | `FLOW_TEMPLATE_PATHS_USER_TEXT` | `flow-template-unknown-field`, `flow-template-lookup-traversal`, `flow-template-field-unprovisioned` |
| `validate-flow-node-writes.ts` | `FLOW_NODE_WRITES_USER_TEXT` | `flow-node-write-unprovisioned-anchor` |
| `validate-readonly-flow-writes.ts` | `READONLY_FLOW_WRITES_USER_TEXT` | `flow-update-readonly-when-field` |
| `lint-flow-credential-literals.ts` | `FLOW_CREDENTIAL_LITERALS_USER_TEXT` | `flow-credential-literal` |

- Push sites set `userTextParams` (flow, node, object, field, input names, plus small arm keys such as `slate`, `locked`, `trigger`, `root`, `position`). Rule ids, `message` and `hint` are unchanged.
- Refusals that share an id with one of these advisories (`approval-expression-invalid`'s error arm, `flow-trigger-unknown-object` / `flow-input-unknown-object` under a package closure) carry no params, so they render no user sentence.
- `flow-credential-literal`'s sentence names where the credential sits (header, query parameter or input name) and never its value.
- `authoring-rules.ts`: the `lintFlowCredentialLiterals` adapter keeps `userTextParams` when it re-maps its findings (one spread, approved by the seat's surface amendment 6855561105), so the publish gate's advisory carries them.
- Changeset `32836-advisory-user-text.md`, `@objectstack/lint` patch.

## Tests

- `finding-user-text.test.ts` gains a shared harness and 25 cases from real flows:
  - exact coverage of each catalog (ids × 11 locales) and its identity in `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG`;
  - every push site rendered from its real finding in every locale, with no `undefined`, no unfilled `${`, every shown name present, and no locale falling back to the English sentence; arms that differ (group vs manager slate, locked vs not, record vs schedule trigger, trigger vs variable root, header vs query vs input) render apart;
  - every case also runs its flow through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules({ type: 'flow' })`, checks the advisory's params, parses it under `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` and compares `userMessage` to the zh-Hans sentence;
  - the refusal arms carry no params; credential sentences never contain the value; the adapter keeps params (ja renders `ヘッダー「Authorization」`).
- `validate-approval-approvers.unsupported-type.test.ts` adds the same pins for `approval-approver-type-unsupported` under its mocked binding table, including a gate advisory parsed for a ko-KR request.

## Acceptance notes

**Re-measure.** The card's table lists 27 ids; a static scan of the listed files finds 29 (action-body-writes 4, not 3; flow-trigger-readiness 5, not 4). Through the save door, 19 reach a user, all on flow writes. This PR writes catalogs and pins for those 19 only, as the seat ruled (it supersedes the amendment's "cover all 29" clause), and writes no dead catalog. Under #32835's Done-when alternative, the 10 ids that never reach the door:

- **(a) the write's snapshot never carries what the rule reads.** These are reference-integrity suite members with no `runtimeTypes`, so they default to `flow`, but a flow write's snapshot carries no hooks or actions. Measured through the gate: `rulesRun` 1 for a hook write, 1 for an action write, 14 for an object-with-action write, and none of these advisories.
  - `hook-body-source-unparseable`, `hook-body-write-unprovisioned-anchor`, `hook-body-write-unknown-field`
  - `action-body-source-unparseable`, `action-record-write-discarded`, `action-body-write-unprovisioned-anchor`, `action-body-write-unknown-field`
  - `hook-api-update-readonly-when-field`, `action-api-update-readonly-when-field`
- **(b) the advisory arm is off at the door.** `email-template-hole-grammar`'s warning arm (rung ④, a platform-prefixed option object) runs only when `liveUniverse` is false; the registry sets `liveUniverse: ctx.runtimeWriteType !== undefined`, so at the door the same hole is an error.

**`approval-approver-type-unsupported`** has no live trigger today (no binding is `unsupported` since `queue` landed), so its sentence is pinned only under the mocked binding table, as its existing message pin is.

**Agent-written sentences for the native-review round.** Every non-English sentence in this PR is agent-written: 19 ids × 10 locales (zh-Hans, zh-Hant, es, ar, fr, pt-BR, ru, de, ja, ko), in the six `*.user-text.ts` files above. Terms follow `ui/packages/i18n` (flow 流程 / 流程 / flujo / التدفق / flux / fluxo / поток / Flow / フロー / 플로우; field 字段 / 欄位 / … / 項目 / 필드; object 对象 / 物件 / … / オブジェクト / 개체). The `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty` and `flow-draft-status-ambiguous` sentences carry the most domain wording and are the best first read.

**Metadata-protocol.** `none`, following #32835's stated reading for its sub-cards. #32790 declared `added`/`yes` because it added a spec field (`userMessage`); this PR adds no spec field.

**Ruling grep** (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔` across the surface, read before editing): approval approvers 14 (manager kept out of the expandable routes; never name an empty-slate outcome or default; tracker ids stay out of strings), flow trigger readiness 9 (#9612 ruling, #29425 ruling A, #7215 maintainer-ruled, ruling G), readonly flow writes 6 (the 2026-09-03 ruling: never say "INSERT is exempt"), flow template paths 1, credential literals 2 (never the value; no url-path promise), `finding-user-text.ts` 2, flow node writes 0. The sentences keep every one of them; none is reversed.

**Serial.** #32837 also adds one line to `finding-user-text.ts`; whichever lands second merges main once and keeps both catalogs.

**Ablations** (both red, both restored to HEAD and verified clean):

- deleting the `authoring-rules.ts` spread: 4 credential gate tests red;
- deleting `userTextParams: { flow: flowName },` at the draft-status push site: 2 tests red.

## Verification

Head `8b347e57`, merged with `origin/main` at `7c36f524`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run`: 202 files, 8692 tests passed (after the merge with main).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` and `tsc --noEmit`: exit 0. `node scripts/check-cli-command-ids.mjs`: exit 0.
- Consumers of the widened finding shape, each its real reading:
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: 337 files passed, 7 skipped; 22799 tests passed, 36 skipped.
  - `@objectstack/objectql`: 595 files, 12789 tests passed.
  - `@objectstack/cli` (the 4 test files naming these rule ids, incl. `flow-credential-literal-doors.e2e.test.ts` and `authoring-rule-command-parity.test.ts`): 63 tests passed.
  - `examples/app-showcase` `test/author-time-advisories.test.ts`: 2 tests passed.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; the derivation at the merged head is identical.

<details><summary>Gate readings that were not exit 0 on the first sweep</summary>

- `check:test-source-alias` exit 1: `validate-approval-approvers.unsupported-type.test.ts` loaded `@objectstack/spec/system` and `@objectstack/spec/api` inside a clocked body. Fixed in af4e1c7c (module-top imports); rerun exit 0.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3: shallow clone could not reach the pinned fixture commit; after fetching it, exit 0.
- `check:docs-transcript-drift` exit 1 and `check:dts-closure` exit 1: ran while a closure build was rewriting `spec/dist`; rerun exit 0.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 and `check:lean-entry-closure` exit 3: prerequisite (no dist); after `pnpm build`, exit 0.
- `check:type-check-debt` exit 124: my 600s per-gate timeout; rerun without it, exit 0.

</details>
